items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: They had some trumpet players in there with my father... His name was De Jong... De Jong was about the sweetest trumpet player that anybody wanted.

ctx.x: You don't remember the funerals? No. That brass band, did they ever jazz up any of the numbers? You know, like here they get swinging pretty much out on the street like they do in the dance.

Pretty good jazz, I'll tell you. Thank you, with the brass band, too. That's right. They had some trumpet players in there with my father. It was under the flag. I've heard a man who's trumpet player here. Of course, this man is dead now. Yes. He got drowned. His name was De Jong. Now, what his last name was, I don't know. His name was De Jong.
Same name like Harold De Jong?
